jobs.title: Software Developer Backend & AI
jobs.description:
M.A.C. Solutions is a specialist provider of Industrial Data Communication, M2M solutions and Change Management solutions for the Process and Automation markets. M.A.C. Solution operates a software division (ProcessVue) offering applications to Alarm Management and IoT Analytics market. With offices in both UK and Europe, M.A.C. Solutions continues to grow nationally and internationally, offering customers the experience to Connect, Secure & Analyse their assets and data.

To keep up with demands from global growth, M.A.C. Solutions is looking to recruit a talented Backend & AI Software Developer who is passionate about software development, is willing to learn on the job and wants to work in a very diverse work environment.

Based in our software development centre in Chesterfield (hybrid/ remote), you will work on the AI and data side of our software as part of the development team, taking care of the following:

* Design and build secure, scalable backend services, APIs and integrations in C# / .NET
* Integrate LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar) into production features: prompts, structured outputs, context handling and error handling
* Control the cost, latency and reliability of AI features, including usage tracking, per-user limits and fallbacks
* Build retrieval and search using embeddings, vector search and RAG over customer data and documents
* Design agentic workflows (orchestration, memory, tool use) and build MCP servers and tools that give AI safe access to our data and systems
* Measure AI output quality with evaluation sets, user feedback scoring and regression checks
* Write and optimise SQL for large event and time-series datasets so dashboards and reports stay fast
* Build real-time features, background jobs, role-based access control and tamper-evident audit logging, with security built in (threat modelling, vulnerability scanning, awareness of the Cyber Resilience Act and AI Act)
* Analyse AI challenges, keep up with emerging AI approaches, and turn creative ideas into working proofs of concept
* Evaluate, fine-tune and deploy local / self-hosted LLMs
* Take part in code reviews and share backend and AI best practice with the team
* Follow QA procedures and processes defined in accordance with ISO 9001.

Engineering Foundation

* SignalR real-time communication experience
* Experience with .NET 10 / C# backend, APIs, async programming and scalable design
* SOLID principles, OOP and able to create clean code
* Experience with dependency injection, constructor injection, service lifetimes and implementing interface-based design
* Separation of concerns and layered architecture thinking
* Unit and integration testing (TDD principles, automated pipelines)
* Familiar with Entity Framework or Dapper or equivalent ORM
* PostgreSQL or Microsoft SQL Server experience.
* Know how to write efficient SQL including schema design and query optimisation
* 3rd party API integration
* Background job processing (Hangfire or equivalent)
* Agile / sprint-based delivery
* Nginx — web deployment and reverse proxy
* Monitoring, logging and troubleshooting of production services
* Experience building and deploying self-hosted / on-premises software
* Role-based access control, audit logging and secure-by-design practices
* Experience optimising queries and indexes on large time-series / event tables
* Experience handling real-time data streams and large datasets — ingestion, aggregation, caching and performance at scale

AI and LLM

* Experience developing using AI tools (Claude Code / GitHub Copilot)
* Hands-on experience connecting to OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar — prompting, context handling, structured outputs
* Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, and semantic similarity
* Production experience shipping LLM-powered features (not only prototypes), including cost, latency, usage limits and fallbacks
* Experience designing retrieval pipelines over customer documents and data — chunking, embeddings, vector storage and semantic search
* Experience measuring AI output quality — evaluation sets, feedback scoring and regression testing
* Hands-on experience designing agentic workflows — orchestrator, memory, and tool-use patterns
* Experience fine-tuning or adapting models (e.g. LoRA / PEFT) and knowing when fine-tuning is better than prompting or RAG
* Experience running local / self-hosted LLMs (e.g. Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp) for on-premises or air-gapped environments

Desirable

* React (TypeScript) component-based frontend development experience
* Tailwind CSS + shadcn/UI experience
* Python — AI tooling and evaluation scripts
* Semantic Kernel (.NET) or LangChain (Python)
* Docker / containerisation — building images, Docker Compose, running services in containers
* Knowledge graph

Other Non-Technical Skills ideally required:

* Good communicator face-to-face, telephone, written and email
* Converse with non-technical stakeholders and convey meaning without jargon
* Able to build and maintain good relationships with stakeholders and colleagues
* Able to manage and prioritise own tasks
* Timely reporting of progress on tasks and escalation within the team when required
* Able to learn and adapt quickly to new skills, products and techniques.

Personal Qualities desired:

* Reliable, responsible and trustworthy character
* Self-disciplined and able to work on own initiative
* Positive, proactive and self-motivated
* Determined, tenacious problem-solver yet with a clear understanding of own limitations
* Adaptable and flexible team player
* Fast learner who keeps up with AI trends and can tell real progress from hype
* Independent and resourceful, able to find solutions without close direction
* Creative and curious, with a habit of proposing better ways to solve problems

Education:

Relevant Higher Education Qualification (BA, BSc) (Preferred)

Experience:

Software Development: 5+ years (backend), hands-on AI/LLM experience

Production experience with LLM / AI-powered features

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: £45,000.00-£55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Cycle to work scheme
* Employee discount
* Employee mentoring programme
* Free parking
* Gym membership
* Health & wellbeing programme
* Paid volunteer time
* Referral programme
* Store discount
* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (preferred)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chesterfield S41 0TZ

jobs.title: Engineering Industrial Placement
jobs.description:
About the Role

At EDF, Success is Personal. We don’t define it, you do. Join our Engineering Industrial Placement and you’ll shape your future while helping Britain achieve net zero. You’ll take on real responsibilities, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to meaningful projects at one of our operational nuclear sites.  
  
“Electricity is such a vital component in everyone’s lives. It powers schools, businesses and hospitals, so I knew that if I did my placement within EDF then I would have a really large impact on society, and that made my placement a lot more fulfilling.” Priyanka, Science and Engineering Industrial Placement  
  
**The Opportunity**  
  
This 12-month placement offers a starting salary of £26,050 and the chance to work at our #Torness Power Station in Scotland.  
  
You’ll apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges in the energy industry. From safety improvements to radiation protection and condition monitoring, this placement offers a wide range of learning opportunities that will help you grow professionally and personally.  
  
**What You’ll Experience**  
  
During your Engineering Industrial Placement, you’ll work on projects that previous students have found rewarding. These include supporting safety campaigns, exploring radiation protection in new power stations, and helping maintain condition monitoring programmes across operational sites.  
  
You’ll be part of a collaborative team, applying your engineering skills to practical challenges and gaining insight into the operations of a nuclear power station. This is a chance to build your confidence, develop technical expertise, and make a real impact.  
  
**Your Work Location**  
  
You’ll be based at our #Torness Power Station in Scotland (EH42), where you’ll work on site and connect with colleagues across the business.  
  
**Who You Are**  
  
To be eligible for this EDF industrial placement, you need to be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a 2:2 undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering or Chemical Engineering.  
  
It is a requirement that those who join us have the right to work in the UK. Whilst sponsorship may be a possibility, we reserve the right in our decisions to give priority to those who already have the right to work in the UK.  
  
To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.  
  
**Pay, Benefits and Culture**  
  
Alongside a starting salary of at least £26,050 per annum and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.  
  
At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That’s why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that’s unique to you. Here, Success is Personal – it’s your journey, powered by us.  
  
Everyone is welcome at EDF; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities.  
  
As a Disability Confident employer, we're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and encourage candidates to tell us about any support they may need. Should you disclose a disability and meet the minimum criteria (which will include holding a relevant degree discipline/grade and achieving the required pass mark for Stage 1 Testing) for the role you’ll be progressed to the first stage of the selection process. Some of our roles at EDF attract large volumes of applications. When this happens, we’ll apply the Disability Confident scheme’s guidance on taking practical and appropriate steps selecting disabled candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job.  
  
**Our Recruitment Process**  
  
We'll guide you through every stage and keep you updated along the way. You'll be supported by real people, with opportunities to ask questions, learn more and receive feedback where possible.  
  
For our Early Careers Programmes, we use a combination of automated decision-making, assessment technology and human review.  
  
Find out more by visiting: https://careers.edfenergy.com/articles/2025-8/AI-and-Automated-Decision-Making-in-Recruitment-at-EDF  
  
Join us and find your success at EDF.  
  
#SuccessIsPersonal #EDFcareers #LI-Onsite #DestinationNuclear #Torness

Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us. Join us and drive the transition towards An Electric Britain.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**About us**

We're a Manchester-based FinTech building a smarter way for tenants to pay rent. Our platform pays landlords the full rent on time and collects smaller instalments from tenants via Open Banking Variable Recurring Payments (VRP). We're a small, high-trust engineering team solving genuinely hard problems in payments, credit, and financial correctness — where getting the maths and the money movement exactly right matters.

**The role**

We're looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to own features end-to-end across our .NET backend and React Native mobile client. You'll work close to the domain — instalment maths, double-entry ledgers, scheduled money movement, and third-party integrations with banking and identity providers. This is a hands-on senior role with real ownership and influence over architecture.

**What you'll work with**

* **Backend:** .NET 10 / C#, EF Core (SQL Server), a service-oriented solution with clean domain boundaries
* **Async & messaging:** MassTransit, background workers, durable/idempotent scheduled jobs
* **Cloud & platform:** Azure, .NET Aspire, containerised services
* **Mobile:** Expo / React Native (TypeScript)
* **Integrations:** Open Banking, VRP, BaaS, identity verification, credit decisioning
* **Practices:** ADR-driven architecture, EF Core migrations, automated testing (MSTest, NSubstitute, FluentAssertions)

**What you'll do**

* Design and ship features spanning the C# backend and the React Native app
* Model financial domains carefully — money, fees, timing differences, ledgers — where precision is non-negotiable
* Build resilient, idempotent background processing for payment execution and scheduling
* Integrate with external banking, payments, and identity providers
* Contribute to architectural decisions

**What we are looking for**

* Strong commercial experience with **C# / .NET** and modern **TypeScript**
* **Solid EF Core** / relational database skills (SQL Server ideal)
* Experience building and consuming APIs, and working with asynchronous/message-based systems
* **React Native (Expo)** experience, or strong React skills and appetite to work across mobile
* A pragmatic, quality-first mindset — you care about correctness, testing, and clear design
* Bonus: FinTech / payments / Open Banking experience, cloud (Azure), event-driven architecture

**Benefits**

* £65k–£85k salary depending on experience
* Hybrid working from our Manchester office
* 25 days holiday + bank holidays
* Pension, and the chance to shape a product (and a team) from an early stage
* Meaningful ownership and a direct line to the impact of your work
* **Sound like you?** Apply with your CV and a short note on something you've built that you're proud of.

Pay: £65,000.00-£85,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Manchester, Greater Manchester: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Application question(s):

* Do you now or in the future require sponsorship for a work visa?
* What are your base salary expectations?

Experience:

* C#: 5 years (required)
* React Native: 2 years (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Manchester
